source: C285_obv.webp (Drive original) read enlarged 2026-10-24: a circular mint mark with the MK monogram inside it sits below the 2009 date, to the left of the Slovak coat of arms - the mint mark of Mincovna Kremnica. The letter Z to the right of the shield is designer Drahomir Zobek's initial (Numista N#5086, https://en.numista.com/catalogue/pieces5086.html: obverse lettering 'SLOVENSKO 2017 Z', engraver Drahomir Zobek), not the mint mark.
